issue: Implement webhook retry with exponential backoff

observations.detail: Tests use a lightweight custom harness (test/assert functions with tsx runner). TestableDeliveryManager subclass overrides the protected sleep() method to skip real delays and capture backoff durations for assertions. Reuse this subclass-override pattern for testing any async code with delays.

Webhook retry module lives at src/middleware/webhook-retry.ts. Exports WebhookDeliveryManager class, calculateBackoff/isRetryableStatus helpers, and TypeScript interfaces (WebhookDelivery, WebhookRetryOptions, DeliveryPayload, DeliveryResult, DeliverRequest). The deliverFn is constructor-injected for testability.
ESM imports use .js extensions (e.g., import from '../middleware/webhook-retry.js'). This matches existing project conventions and is enforced by type: module in package.json.

Exponential backoff uses base-2 with no jitter: delay = baseDelayMs * 2^attempt. Non-5xx responses (including 4xx) are treated as successful delivery to avoid retrying client errors. maxRetries=0 means a single attempt with no retries.

The package.json test script runs only webhook-retry tests. On the master branch, src/ directory does not exist — it only exists on feature branches. When merging multiple feature branches, the test script needs to aggregate all test files.

Remote origin configured at https://github.com/tamirdresher/docs-heavy.git. PR #1 opened: feature/webhook-retry-exponential-backoff → master. All 31 tests pass (verified 2026-04-02). gh CLI auth uses keyring-stored token for tamirdresher account.

31 tests cover: calculateBackoff math, isRetryableStatus boundaries, first-attempt success, 5xx retry with backoff verification, network error retry, dead-letter queue on exhausted retries, status transitions (pending→retrying→delivered/failed), payload shape validation, custom config (maxRetries, baseDelayMs), and config validation errors.
